about.text: Texas Secretary of State Jane Nelson and Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton appeal the district court’s denial of their motions to dismiss for lack of jurisdiction based on sovereign immunity and standing in this lawsuit challenging certain provisions of Texas’s Election Protection and Integrity Act of 2021.
